classifications.rationale: The President mandates that the Secretary of the Treasury later promulgate regulations imposing specified prohibitions and terminating covered judicial proceedings; the legally consequential restrictions arise through those required regulations.
classifications.evidence: The Secretary of the Treasury shall promulgate regulations

classifications.rationale: The segment directs court notification, delegates presidential statutory functions to the Treasury Secretary, and establishes the order's effective timing; these are implementation, delegation, and housekeeping provisions rather than a substantive legal consequence independently imposed by this segment.
classifications.evidence: The Secretary of the Treasury is delegated and authorized to exercise all functions vested in the President
